description: This file declares the VP9Decoder class and its nested VP9Accelerator interface, which implement hardware-accelerated VP9 video decoding within the Chromium media framework. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and member variables related to VP9 decoding, frame management, and accelerator interaction.
external_methods: Status SubmitDecode(scoped_refptr<VP9Picture> pic, const Vp9SegmentationParams& segm_params, const Vp9LoopFilterParams& lf_params, const Vp9ReferenceFrameVector& reference_frames, const base::OnceClosure done_cb)

classes.name: VP9Decoder
classes.description: A class implementing hardware-accelerated VP9 decoding, managing stream input, decoding process, and output within the Chromium media framework.

classes.name: VP9Accelerator
classes.description: An interface for hardware-specific VP9 decoding acceleration, including methods for creating pictures, submitting decode jobs, and outputting pictures.
